# Codex Studio 0.1.29
Customize Your dot with a new dedicated appearance section.
- Distinct blue Dot bubbles and grey replies, with adjustable colors, spacing and corners. - Active wallpaper backgrounds with adjustable dimming and glass softness. - A smooth, centered message composer with rounded clipping and clear separation from the conversation. - Persistent appearance settings and a live preview in Studio.
Includes DreamSkin runtime 1.9.24 and preserves existing themes and appearance preferences.
